about_short_description.short_description: Smart Green offers agri-tech solutions to agricultural enterprises that use Industry 4.0 technology to facilitate digital transformation.

product.name: Smart Irrigation and Fertigation System (Fertigo)
product.description: A system that controls irrigation and fertilizer delivery to optimize water and nutrient use for crops, enabling remote farm management.

product.name: Rootrika Monitoring System
product.description: A precision irrigation system that uses sensors to monitor root zone conditions and provide data for optimized irrigation management.

product.name: Weather-Based Application (Taqs Scope)
product.description: A weather-driven application that informs irrigation and farm management decisions based on meteorological data.

product.name: Crop Simulation Service
product.description: A virtual farming tool that simulates crop growth scenarios to support decision-making on planting, irrigation, and fertilization strategies.

product.name: Agricultural Water Management Diagnostic Services
product.description: Consulting services that assess water quality, irrigation efficiency, and soil health to identify and address farm water management challenges.
